metadata.numeric_target_policy: Only explicitly reported values with a named assay, unit, source location, and provenance are entered. Assay and duration mismatch prevents direct biological equivalence.
metadata.scientific_scope: Conditional computational calibration of existing locomotion metrics; not biological validation, diagnosis, clinical prediction, or treatment evidence.
metadata.approval_note: A research lead must review the source locations, units, genotype, age, assay, and transfer assumptions before this target set is used as an official calibration dataset.

targets.citation: Riemensperger et al. (2011), Behavioral consequences of dopamine deficiency in the Drosophila central nervous system, PNAS, DOI: 10.1073/pnas.1010930108, PMID: 21187381
targets.model_context: 5-day-old adult flies with neural dopamine deficiency, DTHgFS+/-; ple context
targets.assay: Spontaneous walking in an open arena; reported median walking speed
targets.source_location: Figure 2A and Results section: DA deficiency reduces activity and arousal
targets.notes: The paper reports 7.8 mm/s for the dopamine-deficient group. FlyGym uses a short flat-ground simulated rollout, so this is a provisional transfer target rather than a directly equivalent experimental endpoint.

targets.citation: Pokrzywa et al. (2017), Effects of small-molecule amyloid modulators on a Drosophila model of Parkinson's disease, PLOS ONE, DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0184117
targets.model_context: Adult female flies expressing human alpha-synuclein under nSyb-GAL4; value described within the first 3 weeks
targets.assay: FlyTracker locomotion tracking in vials; 10-second recordings at 30 frames/s, repeated weekly
targets.source_location: Figure 2A and Results section: Age-dependent climbing deficits in PD flies
targets.notes: The paper states that alpha-synuclein flies decline from 5.6 mm/s to 2.5 mm/s within the first 3 weeks. The exact age corresponding to the endpoint is not encoded here; retain this as an independent paper-level holdout with an explicit context limitation.
